mcq: Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is regarded as a perfect substitute of the product of other firms."
Product of each firm is regarded as a perfect substitute of the product of other firms.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a market where money instruments are bought and sold."
The money market is a market where money instruments are bought and sold.

The Nigerian Stock Exchange (NSE) The stock exchange is a market where those who want to buy or sell shares, stocks, government bonds, debentures, and other approved securities, can do so (though only through its members (stockbrokers).
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ refer to the joint stock banks which are financial institutions that enhance the economic development of Nigeria."
Commercial Banks refer to the joint stock banks which are financial institutions that enhance the economic development of Nigeria.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a contrast to opportunity cost."
Actual cost is a contrast to opportunity cost.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a tool of analysis used to explain the input-output relationship."
Production function is a tool of analysis used to explain the input-output relationship.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an input into ice cream production."
Sugar is an input into ice cream production.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined, and described how it is determined. 5."
State how the unemployment rate is defined, and described how it is determined. 5.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the weighted average of price movements of several thousand goods and services grouped into several hundred categories."
The CPI is the weighted average of price movements of several thousand goods and services grouped into several hundred categories.

Explicit costs are those costs that fall under actual or business costs and are entered into the account books.

The market demand curve is the sum of individuals' demand curves.

Positive economics is concerned with what is, with describing how the economy functions.

Unadjusted GDP is known as nominal GDP (NYt).

Economics is the study of how individuals and societies choose to use the scarce resources that nature and previous generations have provided.

The demand curve is a horizontal line and is parallel to the X axis.

Elasticity of demand is a measure of the extent to which the quantity demanded of a good responds to changes in some factors that influence demand.

Market demand refers to the demand for the industry as a whole.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ means different things to different people."
Profit means different things to different people.

An output is any good or service that comes out of production process.

AFC is an asymptomatically sloped, while MC, AC and AVC are all U- shaped owing to the law of diminishing returns to scale.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is defined as one whose supply in the short run is elastic e.g. labour and raw materials."
A variable input is defined as one whose supply in the short run is elastic e.g. labour and raw materials.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is concerned mainly with the distribution of that pie among different claimants and other social objectives."
Fairness or equity is concerned mainly with the distribution of that pie among different claimants and other social objectives.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is an attempt to view how managers relate with the external environment."
The organisation environment theory is an attempt to view how managers relate with the external environment.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is a situation whereby a country's receipts and payments are equalized."
Balance of payment equilibrium is a situation whereby a country's receipts and payments are equalized.

Note also that quantity supplied is the amount that firms are willing to offer for sale; it is not necessarily the amount that they succeed in selling.

GDP is the value of the final goods and services produced in the economy, by foreign or domestic firms, during a given year. 3.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ are the success of monopoly power."
The barriers to entry are the success of monopoly power.
Complete the statement from the course material: "______ is the key and the most watched indicator."
The unemployment rate is the key and the most watched indicator.
